final.convention: Minimization: gradient(f) - J_nonlinear' * dual_nonlinear - J_regular' * dual_regular. JuMP/MOI duals; all terms in original physical coordinates. Fixed coordinates reported separately.
final.scope: Read-only derivative and KKT diagnostics, not proof of optimality or an independent acceptance rule. Row scale = 1/max(initial row infinity norm,1); no scaling is applied to the solve. Norm ranges are not condition numbers.
